name: ترک عادت بد
description: A Persian user asks how to quit bad habits in several phrasings. Verifies the habits_breaking fact answers in Persian (awareness of triggers, replacement, environment, urge surfing, no self-blame).

turns.text: چطور عادت بد رو ترک کنم؟

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: "چطور عادت بد رو ترک کنم" returns the habits_breaking fact. Turn 2: "ترک عادت بد چطور ممکنه" returns it too. Turn 3: the possessive form "عادت بدمو" also matches.
expected.behavior: Persian keywords cover the collocation variants (عادت بد رو ترک کنم, ترک عادت بد, عادت بدمو) so real typing variations all route to the same fact.
